questions.question: When following another vehicle at night, what lights should you use?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when you are within 300 feet of another vehicle. High beams shine into the other driver's eyes and mirrors, making it hard for them to see.

questions.question: When driving in fog, what lights should you use?
questions.explanation: Use low beams in fog, rain, or snow. High beams bounce off the moisture in the air and make it even harder to see.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: You see a pedestrian crossing your lane ahead with no crosswalk. What should you do?

options.text: Make eye contact and then pass the pedestrian
Slow down as you pass the pedestrian
Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians crossing in your lane, even without a marked crosswalk. Let them cross safely before you continue driving.

questions.question: When should you adjust your rearview and side mirrors?

options.text: Whenever you need to use them
Before you get into the car

questions.explanation: Adjust your mirrors before you start driving. You should also adjust your seat, fasten your seatbelt, and secure any items. Do not adjust mirrors while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop
You will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing
You should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Cross only when it is safe.

questions.question: The MVA will suspend a driver's license if the driver:

options.text: Refuses to use a fake ID to buy alcohol
Fails to meet school attendance requirements
Refuses to take a blood alcohol test

questions.correctAnswerText: Refuses to take a blood alcohol test
questions.explanation: If you refuse to take a blood alcohol test, the MVA will suspend your license. This is true even though you cannot be forced to take the test.

questions.question: When can you safely drive at the maximum posted speed limit?
questions.explanation: The posted speed limit is the fastest you can legally drive when conditions are perfect. Slow down in bad weather, heavy traffic, or other unsafe conditions. Drive at the same speed as the traffic around you.

questions.question: What is an important step before turning?

options.text: Always move to the left lane

questions.explanation: Before turning, look behind your vehicle and to both sides to make sure it is safe. Slow down to complete the turn safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. It is unsafe and against the law to turn right here.

questions.question: What does a steady green traffic light mean?

options.text: You can go through the intersection at a safe speed if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can go through the intersection at a safe speed if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A green light means you may proceed. Always check that the intersection is clear of other traffic and pedestrians before you go.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs harm many driving skills. They slow your reaction time, hurt your coordination, reduce your alertness, and make it hard to focus.

questions.question: You see pedestrians near the road. What should you do?

options.text: Honk and keep your speed the same.
Speed up to leave the area quickly.

questions.explanation: When you see pedestrians near the road, slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: Which of these is against the law?

options.text: Passing another vehicle in a marked no passing zone.
Passing another vehicle over a railroad crossing.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to pass in no passing zones, at railroad crossings, on hills, in curves, or where you cannot see far ahead. Do not pass at street crossings or in work zones where it is not safe.

questions.question: When turning left at an intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Oncoming traffic and pedestrians should yield to you.
Never yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: When turning left, you must let oncoming traffic and pedestrians go first. Wait until the intersection is clear and the signal allows you to turn.

questions.question: Fatigue increases the risk of:
questions.explanation: Fatigue makes you slow to react and makes decisions harder. You could fall asleep behind the wheel and crash, hurting yourself or others.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead that need your attention.

questions.question: If you have had several beers, the effects of alcohol will be reduced only by:
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. Coffee, cold showers, and exercise do not speed up this process. One drink takes about one hour to wear off.

questions.question: What do "No passing zone" signs tell drivers?

options.text: It is not safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is not safe to pass.
questions.explanation: A "No passing zone" sign means it is illegal to pass in that area. The road ahead does not have good visibility, making passing unsafe.

questions.question: You must yield to a pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog:

options.text: Only when the guide dog is leading the person across the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: Always give the right-of-way to pedestrians using guide dogs or white canes.

questions.question: What can you do to reduce road rage?

options.text: Always use your turn signal when changing lanes.
Talk on your cell phone while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always use your turn signal when changing lanes.
questions.explanation: To help prevent road rage, follow all traffic laws, signs, signals, and road markings. Always use your turn signal when changing lanes.

questions.question: What can happen if you take a prescription drug while drinking alcohol?

options.text: There will likely be no effect.
It will make you more alert.
It can make you unfit to drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can make you unfit to drive.
questions.explanation: Prescription and over-the-counter medications can impair your driving ability. They are especially dangerous when combined with alcohol.

questions.question: If you have an argument with someone and feel angry, you should:

options.text: Play loud music while driving so you won't think about the argument.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Drive on the interstate to release the stress.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect your driving safety. If you are very angry, excited, afraid, worried, or sad, take time to calm down before driving. You need to focus mentally on driving without being distracted by upsetting thoughts.

questions.question: Before moving back to your original lane after passing another vehicle, you should:

options.text: See both headlights of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: See both headlights of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: When passing is allowed, watch for both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror. Only then is it safe to return to your original lane.

questions.question: Texting while driving a motor vehicle is:

options.text: Allowed if you are driving slowly.
Legal if you are 21 years old or older.

questions.explanation: Maryland law prohibits using handheld cell phones while driving. Hands-free devices are allowed, but drivers should limit calls and focus on safe driving. Any cell phone use while driving is distracted driving and raises your risk of an accident.
